zone.label: Dry sub-humid
zone.method: Índice de aridez = lluvia / ET0 (FAO-56 Penman-Monteith) por celda de POWER; clases UNEP.

reasons: It is 6 km from the border with the semi-arid zone (threshold: 25 km).
In 36 % of years (about 4 in 10) it behaved like another zone.
transition.message: Your field is in a transition zone between dry sub-humid and semi-arid: depending on the year, it behaves like one or the other.

options.title: More drought-tolerant crops
options.detail: Millet, Rye, Perennial pasture, Sorghum, Sunflower, Alfalfa
options.reason: They keep medium or high suitability in both zones: they yield less in the wet year, but fall less in the dry one.
options.source: AgroOrbit crop catalog (tolerances to be validated with INTA)

options.title: Cover crops
options.detail: Vetch, Legume cover crop, Grass cover crop
options.reason: They shield the soil from wind in dry years and use the water of wet ones. In dry years, terminate them early so they don't spend the next crop's water.
options.source: AgroOrbit crop catalog (tolerances to be validated with INTA); FAO, conservation agriculture

options.title: Flexible planting date
options.detail: Decide the date and the crop based on the water in the profile at planting time.
options.reason: In a transition zone, the year defines the behavior: measure the profile (and look at SMAP for context) before deciding.
options.source: NASA SMAP (regional context) and measurement in the field

options.title: Fallow to store water
options.detail: A clean, residue-covered fallow before the most demanding crop.
options.reason: It stores part of the fallow's rain in the profile for the next crop (fallow efficiency: an engine assumption).
